'''Signing in''' to [[Melek.salon|melek.salon]] lets you post, reply, vote and follow. Every one of those actions is a transaction signed with one of your account's keys. Part of [[Posting on MELEK]].

== How to sign in ==
Open [https://melek.salon/login.html melek.salon/login.html], or choose '''Log in''' in the header. Enter your account name, then your '''posting key''' (a private key starting with 5) or your account password. Tick '''Keep me logged in''' on a device only you use. You can also sign in with the Keychain browser extension, which keeps keys in the extension instead of the page.

== Which key to use ==
A MELEK account has several keys with different powers:
* '''Posting key''': posts, replies, votes, follows. This is the key to sign in with.
* '''Active key''': transfers, powering up, witness votes. Use it only in the wallet, when you move funds.
* '''Owner key''': changes the other keys and recovers the account. Keep it offline. Never type it into a website to post.
* '''Memo key''': encrypts and decrypts private memos.
Signing in with only the posting key means a lost or stolen session cannot move your money.

== Where your keys go ==
The key is used in your browser to sign each action. It is not sent to the operator's server. Keys for new accounts are generated in the browser at [https://melek.salon/account/signup.html signup] for the same reason.

== Lost a key? ==
If you still have your password or owner key, set new keys with '''Change Account Password''' in the menu. If an account is taken over, recovery runs through [https://signer.melek.salon/recover signer.melek.salon/recover].
